findings.title: Provider Default Truncation
findings.body:
When a request omits `maxTokens`, the gateway now sends no output limit, and each provider SDK falls back to its own default. Previously the default was a 32k cap.

Some providers require `max_tokens`. For those, the AI SDK adapter supplies a small default. For example, `@ai-sdk/anthropic` has historically used 4096. Callers that relied on the implicit 32k cap could get truncated responses (`finishReason: "length"`), with no error raised.

Uncertain: this depends on the installed AI SDK provider versions. It is worth checking Anthropic and Bedrock paths before merging.

findings.title: Lost Overflow Warning
findings.body:
`resolveGatewayRequestMaxTokens`, and so the `onContextOverflow` callback, now runs only when `request.maxTokens` is set. Requests without `maxTokens` no longer log "Estimated prompt tokens exceed model context window", even when the prompt clearly overflows the context window. This removes a useful diagnostic for the most common case.

Estimating input tokens and checking the context window separately would keep the warning, without synthesizing a max-tokens value.
